description: Shows the Kimi Code 5-hour and monthly limits in bb's usage panel, where no collector reads them. The panel covers the OpenCode Go and Claude Code subscriptions only, so a Kimi Code plan shows nothing; this adds the windows Kimi reports, with the percentage used and the reset time. The row appears only when the Kimi Code ACP provider is installed, and a host whose login expired drops out instead of leaving an empty row. Requires a Kimi Code subscription signed in on the host.
